subtitle: Lesson 4 · SOQL Fundamentals

code:
-- Not valid SOQL:
SELECT * FROM Account

-- No arbitrary JOIN either:
SELECT o.Name, a.Industry
FROM Opportunity o
JOIN Account a ON o.AccountId = a.Id  -- invalid
caption: No SELECT *, and no JOIN keyword at all.

code:
-- Does NOT exist:
UPDATE Account SET Industry = 'Technology'

-- Data changes go through DML instead:
Apex / API / Data Loader / Workbench
caption: No UPDATE, DELETE, or INSERT statements in SOQL -- ever.
